name: ATR + Parabolic SAR strategy: enter on Nth trend bar after SAR flip
author: QuantNomad
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
entry_long: After PSAR flips from short to long (close >= previous PSAR), enter long on the Nth bar of the new trend (entry_bars default 1).
entry_short: After PSAR flips to short enter short on Nth trend bar.
exit: Opposite flip of PSAR reverses the position (short on -N trend bar).
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: ATR(14) is computed in the script for sizing/stops variants; entry/reversal logic is PSAR-flip driven. Verify atr use before treating as stop.
